label: Location first
text: I want to make sure we can get help to you quickly. Where are you right now? Please share the address or a nearby landmark.

label: Are you safe?
text: Are you safe right now? Is anyone with you?

label: Help is on the way
text: Help is on the way. I am going to stay with you until they arrive. Can you keep your phone close to you?

label: Staying on the line
text: You are not alone, I am right here with you. Let's take a slow breath together.

label: Follow-up consent
text: Would it be okay for us to contact you tomorrow to check how you are doing?
